high_level_description: stc brand style, a panoramic nighttime photograph of desert rock formations under a starry sky.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A deep purple and blue night sky filled with bright stars, and a subtle orange glow along the horizon where the sky meets the dark rock formations.

elements.desc: Rugged sandstone rock formations with sharp angular shapes and natural erosion patterns, illuminated by warm orange-red lighting.
